rules.statement: A gift to a concubine is not ipso jure void under Roman-Dutch Law, and such a gift cannot be taken away on the grounds of immorality.
rules.supporting_quote: "The only ground on which the plaintiff could succeed would be on the ground of immoral consideration, which it would not lie in the mouth of Don Davit to aver, on the principle that he ought not to succeed in a court of law on the basis of his own turpitude."
